exportConfirm.expression: { onClick: runExport, "aria-disabled": !canExport.value, style: canExport.value ? undefined : styles.disabled, }

exportPlatform.expression: { value: platformLabel.value, readonly: true, style: styles.opaquePointer, }

exportRootPath.expression: { value: directoryLabel.value, placeholder: "Choose a folder…", readonly: true, onClick: chooseDirectory, style: styles.opaquePointer, }

exportWorkspaceName.expression: { value: workspaceName.value, placeholder: "Untitled workspace", onInput: onNameInput, onBlur: commitName, onKeydown: commitNameOnEnter, style: styles.opaque, }
